findings.description: For a master loading keys from disk whose slot has no owner and is not importing, clusterIsMySlot returns false, so this loop deletes the keys before clusterClaimUnassignedSlots runs. The latter then sees an empty slot and cannot claim it. The base implementation claimed such slots without deleting their data; exclude slots with getNodeBySlot(i) == NULL from this deletion pass.
findings.failureMode: On startup with persisted keys in a populated but unassigned slot, verification deletes the only copy instead of taking ownership.
findings.title: Preserve keys in unassigned slots

findings.description: Replacing zmalloc with malloc makes the required make REDIS_CFLAGS="-Werror" build fail: server.h explicitly marks malloc deprecated, and cluster.c:2138 now triggers -Wdeprecated-declarations. It also bypasses memory tracking and violates repository rule 2. Use zmalloc as in the original startup allocation.
findings.failureMode: The required warnings-as-errors build fails on the new direct malloc call; non-Werror builds omit this allocation from Redis memory accounting.
findings.title: Restore zmalloc for slot-statistics allocation

findings.description: clusterDeleteKeysInUnownedSlots is only called from verifyClusterConfigWithData in this file, but is defined with external linkage. This violates repository rule 7 requiring single-file helpers to be static and unnecessarily exports this implementation symbol. Declare it static.
findings.failureMode: A single-file implementation helper has external linkage instead of the mandated static linkage.
findings.title: Make the unowned-slot helper static

findings.description: With warming enabled and the first CSD email older than 42 days, Infinity flows unchanged into `EmailService.createEmail` as `csd_email_count`. Integer schema validation rejects it with `Value in [emails.csd_email_count] is not an integer.`, so every subsequent newsletter fails before scheduling. Clamp the result to emailCount in createEmail before persisting it.
findings.failureMode: With domain warming enabled and a first CSD email older than 42 days, every new newsletter fails integer schema validation and cannot be scheduled.
findings.title: Normalize Infinity before persisting the email count

findings.description: With at least 237 recipients, a second newsletter one minute after the first is assigned day 1 by `Math.ceil`, raising the CSD limit from 200 to 236 on the same day. Each later step is similarly applied early. Use `Math.floor` for completed elapsed days to preserve the required same-day cap.
findings.failureMode: Two first-day sends to at least 237 members use different custom-domain warmup caps; the second sends excess CSD volume.
findings.title: Count completed warmup days instead of rounding upward

findings.description: The new progression expects nearest-integer volumes (237 on day 1, 5814 on day 20, 31344 on day 30), but `Math.floor` produces 236, 5813, and 31343. Two new unit tests fail, and the MySQL integration helper also uses `Math.round`. Use `Math.round` for the volume calculation.
findings.failureMode: The new limit calculation returns incorrect integer volumes and fails the unit progression assertions.
findings.title: Round the exponential recipient limit

findings.description: At exactly 42 elapsed days, this `>` check leaves a finite cap of 236701 instead of returning Infinity. A million-recipient newsletter still routes 763299 recipients through fallback after the six-week period, and the new day-42 unit test fails. Use `>=` for the completion check.
findings.failureMode: Day-42 warmup returns a finite limit and the new completion unit test fails.
findings.title: End warmup at the 42-day boundary

findings.description: The Nest build emits a CommonJS require for this source-only @calcom/features subpath. The features package has makeActor.ts but no makeActor.js or export map, and start:prod runs plain Node against compiled output, so loading the booking service fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Import makeUserActor from @calcom/platform-libraries/bookings, where this PR already exports the bundled implementation.
findings.failureMode: Production API v2 cannot load the booking service because the new runtime import resolves to an unbuilt TypeScript subpath.
findings.title: Import the actor factory through the built platform library

findings.description: When a PENDING booking is confirmed without recurringEventId, the new audit payload hard-codes oldStatus to ACCEPTED, so onBookingAccepted records ACCEPTED → ACCEPTED instead of PENDING → ACCEPTED. Use booking.status from the pre-update booking for oldStatus.
findings.failureMode: Single booking acceptance writes a false previous status and fails the added pending-to-accepted assertion.
findings.title: Capture the original status for single-booking acceptance

findings.description: fireBookingAcceptedEvent queues acceptance for the entire series before any prisma.booking.update is executed. If an update fails (for example an occurrence is deleted concurrently), audit tasks already claim ACCEPTED for bookings that remain PENDING and retries may enqueue duplicate claims. Emit audits only for successful updates after committing the state change, as the single-booking branch does.
findings.failureMode: Failed recurring confirmation leaves committed acceptance audit records for unconfirmed bookings.
findings.title: Emit recurring acceptance audits after the updates succeed

findings.description: A stored version-1 REJECTED record uses rejectionReason: {old, new}, but the version-1 stored schema now expects a string or null. BookingAuditViewerService calls parseStored without recovery, so such a record makes the whole booking audit-history request fail with ZodError. Keep the original v1 stored schema and version/migrate the scalar representation separately.
findings.failureMode: Previously stored REJECTED v1 audit records cannot be decoded with the replaced v1 schema.
findings.title: Version the incompatible rejection audit format

findings.description: With both TLS flags enabled and SMTP_LOCAL_HOSTNAME unset, the deleted `smtp.ehlo(self.server)` calls become `smtp.ehlo("")`. smtplib substitutes the container's detected hostname/private-IP literal, so relays requiring a public FQDN reject previously working mail; the reproduction fails with SMTPNotSupportedError. Use the configured override when present and fall back to self.server for both STARTTLS EHLO calls otherwise.
findings.failureMode: An existing Docker STARTTLS deployment using a relay that requires a public FQDN stops delivering registration/password-reset emails after an upgrade with SMTP_LOCAL_HOSTNAME unset.
findings.title: Retain the STARTTLS greeting when the override is unset

findings.description: This new field grows the backend module from 1,340 to 1,346 lines, widening its violation of AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md rule 5, which requires backend Python files to contain fewer than 800 lines of code. Even excluding blank/comment lines, it now contains 1,073 lines. Split the feature settings into compliant-sized modules, including MailConfig, rather than extend this over-budget file.
findings.failureMode: The new SMTP_LOCAL_HOSTNAME field adds code to an already oversized backend Python module, violating the mandatory file-size limit.
findings.title: Extract mail settings instead of extending the oversized module

findings.description: Skeleton is never referenced, and tsconfig.app.json enables noUnusedLocals. Running the registered type-check command produces TS6133 at this import; npm run build starts with the same TypeScript build, so this addition prevents the UI from building. Remove the unused import.
findings.failureMode: Both TypeScript validation and the production UI build fail with TS6133 because of the new unused Skeleton import.
findings.title: Remove the unused import that blocks the build

findings.description: For an uncached flow, this Suspense boundary uses an implicit null fallback, leaving the component blank and swallowing the enclosing Loading... fallback in the supplied story. A delayed-query render confirms an empty DOM, whereas FlowLink displays its Skeleton. Add the Skeleton fallback to this boundary so the promised loading UI is displayed.
findings.failureMode: Rendering FlowIconText for an uncached flow with a pending network request produces no icon, name or loading placeholder; its internal Suspense consumes the ancestor's fallback.
findings.title: Provide a fallback for the inner Suspense boundary

findings.description: The new FlowIconText component has no flow-icon-text.test.tsx alongside it. AGENTS.md rule 10 requires a co-located test for each React component, and ui-v2/AGENTS.md requires tests for all new components. The focused Vitest run reports no test files; add the required rendering, fetching and link-target tests.
findings.failureMode: Adding FlowIconText without its corresponding test file fails the repository's explicit new-component and co-location test requirements.
findings.title: Add the required co-located component tests

findings.description: This test is now synchronous and removes 'await fulfillment(of: [exp], timeout: 2.0)' without a replacement wait. A localhost image download still completes asynchronously, so the test returns and can pass before any of its raster-size or success assertions run; a stalled or broken download no longer fails this test. Restore the expectation and fulfill/wait for the callback, as the other download tests do.
findings.failureMode: The standard SVG download test completes successfully without observing its asynchronous image result, masking image parsing or download failures.
findings.title: Wait for the standard SVG download assertions

findings.description: Schema generation reads the Tauri version from `crates/tauri-cli/metadata-v2.json`, which still says `2.8.2`. Consequently, the required `check generated files` job regenerates this `$id` (and the identical one in `crates/tauri-schema-generator/schemas/config.schema.json:3`) as `/2.8.2`, then fails `has-diff.sh`. Update the metadata's `tauri` entry to `2.8.3` before regenerating the schemas.
findings.failureMode: The schema-generation CI job restores both changed schema IDs to the unchanged metadata version 2.8.2 and fails its git-diff check.
findings.title: Sync Tauri's metadata before changing the schema IDs

findings.description: The new `homepage = "https://tauri.app/"` duplicates `[workspace.package].homepage`, although AGENTS.md rule 17 requires workspace members to inherit that field. `tauri-bundler` is a workspace member, so this newly added metadata violates the mandate. Use `homepage.workspace = true` instead.
findings.failureMode: New explicit homepage metadata duplicates the workspace field and fails mandatory workspace metadata inheritance compliance.
findings.title: Inherit the bundler homepage from workspace metadata
